tagline: Recent records, search history, favorites, and Ctrl+K quick reopen
problem: Users lose time reopening the same records and repeating the same searches across Odoo menus.
solution: Smart Search remembers viewed records and search queries per user, then surfaces them in a workspace, systray, and Ctrl+K command palette.
benefits: Reopen recent sale orders, contacts, leads, invoices, and products faster
Keep favorite records one click away
Ctrl+K quick access without custom shortcuts
Built for Odoo 20 Community with OWL 2 assets

features.title: View tracking
features.text: Automatically logs recently opened records on supported business documents.

features.title: Search history
features.text: Stores recent search queries and lets users reopen filtered lists quickly.

features.title: Workspace
features.text: Grouped favorites, recent views, and recent searches in one dashboard.

features.title: Ctrl+K provider
features.text: Adds recent history items to the standard command palette.

features.title: Systray shortcut
features.text: Open recent views or jump to the workspace from the top bar.

features.title: Retention controls
features.text: Configure max history, remember toggles, and stale entry cleanup.

workflow: Press Ctrl+K or open the workspace
Pin favorites and reopen records instantly
